WITH SRC AS
(
SELECT DISTINCT
    ISNULL(LAST_NM,'') AS LAST_NM
	,ISNULL(FIRST_NM,'') AS FIRST_NM
	,ISNULL(MIDDLE_NM,'') AS MIDDLE_NM
	,ISNULL(EMAIL,'') AS EMAIL
	,ISNULL(MOBILE_NO,'') AS MOBILE_NO
	,ISNULL(COUNTRY_CD,'') AS COUNTRY_CD
	,ISNULL(CIF_NO,'') AS CIF_NO
	,ISNULL(USER_ID,'') AS USER_ID
	,ISNULL(LAST_LOGIN_DT,'') AS LAST_LOGIN_DT
	,ISNULL(BNK_CODE,'') AS BNK_CODE
	,ISNULL(SOURCE_CODE,'') AS SOURCE_CODE
	,ISNULL(FILE_NAME,'') AS FILE_NAME
	,ISNULL(insert_dttm,'') AS insert_dttm
FROM BUSC.MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB
),
TGT AS 
(
SELECT DISTINCT
    ISNULL(LAST_NM,'') AS LAST_NM
	,ISNULL(FIRST_NM,'') AS FIRST_NM
	,ISNULL(MIDDLE_NM,'') AS MIDDLE_NM
	,ISNULL(EMAIL,'') AS EMAIL
	,ISNULL(MOBILE_NO,'') AS MOBILE_NO
	,ISNULL(COUNTRY_CD,'') AS COUNTRY_CD
	,ISNULL(CIF_NO,'') AS CIF_NO
	,ISNULL(USER_ID,'') AS USER_ID
	,ISNULL(LAST_LOGIN_DT,'') AS LAST_LOGIN_DT
	,ISNULL(BANK_CODE,'') AS BANK_CODE
	,ISNULL(SOURCE_CODE,'') AS SOURCE_CODE
	,ISNULL(FILE_NAME,'') AS FILE_NAME
	,ISNULL(insert_dttm,'') AS insert_dttm
FROM SYN.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB
)
SELECT count(1) 
FROM SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TGT
    ON SRC.LAST_NM =  TGT.LAST_NM
	AND SRC.FIRST_NM =  TGT.FIRST_NM
	AND SRC.MIDDLE_NM =  TGT.MIDDLE_NM
	AND SRC.EMAIL =  TGT.EMAIL
	AND SRC.MOBILE_NO =  TGT.MOBILE_NO
	AND SRC.COUNTRY_CD =  TGT.COUNTRY_CD
	AND SRC.CIF_NO =  TGT.CIF_NO
	AND SRC.USER_ID =  TGT.USER_ID
	AND SRC.LAST_LOGIN_DT =  TGT.LAST_LOGIN_DT
	AND SRC.BNK_CODE =  TGT.BANK_CODE
	AND SRC.SOURCE_CODE =  TGT.SOURCE_CODE
	AND SRC.FILE_NAME =  TGT.FILE_NAME
	AND SRC.insert_dttm =  TGT.insert_dttm

WHERE (
    SRC.LAST_NM IS NULL OR TGT.LAST_NM IS NULL
	OR SRC.FIRST_NM IS NULL OR TGT.FIRST_NM IS NULL
	OR SRC.MIDDLE_NM IS NULL OR TGT.MIDDLE_NM IS NULL
	OR SRC.EMAIL IS NULL OR TGT.EMAIL IS NULL
	OR SRC.MOBILE_NO IS NULL OR TGT.MOBILE_NO IS NULL
	OR SRC.COUNTRY_CD IS NULL OR TGT.COUNTRY_CD IS NULL
	OR SRC.CIF_NO IS NULL OR TGT.CIF_NO IS NULL
	OR SRC.USER_ID IS NULL OR TGT.USER_ID IS NULL
	OR SRC.LAST_LOGIN_DT IS NULL OR TGT.LAST_LOGIN_DT IS NULL
	OR SRC.BNK_CODE IS NULL OR TGT.BANK_CODE IS NULL
	OR SRC.SOURCE_CODE IS NULL OR TGT.SOURCE_CODE IS NULL
	OR SRC.FILE_NAME IS NULL OR TGT.FILE_NAME IS NULL
	OR SRC.insert_dttm IS NULL OR TGT.insert_dttm IS NULL
)
